Edge is made for thrill-seekers who crave mystery, intensity, and high-stakes drama. From mind-bending thrillers to gripping crime and fast-paced medical stories, this channel delivers bold, pulse-pounding narratives.

Shows: My Secret,Terrius Ep.11 (English Dub), My Secret,Terrius Ep.12 (English Dub), My Secret,Terrius Ep.13 (English Dub), My Secret,Terrius Ep.14 (English Dub), My Secret,Terrius Ep.15 (English Dub)
